<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break an alkyl halide (the leaving group) and form a primary amine, which corresponds to an SN2 substitution.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
